title: Scenario orientation
scenario: One morning every freezer in Zava's five pilot stores is warm, and the only alarms all night were for other cases. The night costs the pilot region €260,411, and the same night across 400 stores would cost about €20.8M.
why: Everyone in the room needs to see the same night and the same money before anyone talks about fixes. The Cost of a Silent Night is the figure the Investment Board judges on Day 3.
objective: Say what the Silent Night cost, where that figure comes from on Business impact, and what must not change.

steps: Watch the trainer's screen as silent-night replays at ×60. If the monitor already runs on your laptop, follow along on [Business impact](/#/business).
Note each alarm as it fires: the time, the case and the store. Write down anything that surprises you.

steps.text: At 08:00, read the newspaper headline and the Cost of a Silent Night by component. To see how that figure is worked out, paste this prompt into Copilot Chat.

prompt.label: Explain the cost model
prompt.text: For project zava-silent-night, explain how `data/business.json` and `zava_cold_chain/business.py` price one night. List each cost component and the assumption behind it, and say which assumptions are shown as sliders on Business impact. Don't change any files.

steps: Move one assumption slider, for example how many stores the chain has, and watch the chain-wide figure change. Put it back afterwards.
Write one sentence on what must not change: a scheduled defrost that ends on time raises no alarm.

ask: What did you expect to see on the screen at 02:00 that you didn't?
Which of these numbers would you put your name to?
In your own company, who would be first to know a freezer was warm?
mistakes: Jumping to a fix before the night has finished replaying
Treating the €20.8M as a forecast when it is a what-if built from the sliders
step_in: When a table starts naming a culprit. Steer them back to what each person on shift could see.

before: Pick a secret seed for the hidden nights, any whole number. Don't use 2026: participants can run that one themselves.
On the untouched code, score the baseline with `python -m zava_cold_chain gauntlet --seed 2026 --baseline`, putting your secret seed in place of 2026. It writes `scorecards/baseline.json`.
Start `python -m zava_cold_chain serve --scorecards scorecards` on the trainer's screen and leave it running.
Agree how tables hand in scorecards: a shared folder, a chat channel or a USB stick.
Print the character cards from [docs/facilitator.md](docs/facilitator.md) for the coaches, one card per coach and never the case file.

run.do: Welcome the room. State the outcome: cut the Cost of a Silent Night without breaking routine operations, measured on hidden nights on Day 3.
Replay silent-night at ×60 on Business impact. Pause at 01:15 and 02:00 and ask what each person on shift could see at that moment.
Stop at 08:00 on the newspaper. Read the headline aloud, then show €260,411 for the pilot region and about €20.8M chain-wide.
Form tables and give each one a coach. Point everyone to chapter 02.

facilitator.good_answer: Someone at each table can say, without notes, that the night cost €260,411 in the pilot region and about €20.8M across 400 stores, and that a scheduled defrost which ends on time must not raise an alarm.
watch_for: Executives leaving before the euro figure lands at 08:00
Anyone who has read the case file naming the cause early. Ask them to keep it to themselves.
facilitator.demo: Replay silent-night at ×60 and stop at 08:00 on the newspaper. Then move the chain size slider so the room sees the chain-wide figure move with one assumption.

done_when: Your table has written down the pilot-region cost: €260,411
Your table has written down what must not change: a scheduled defrost that ends on time raises no alarm
Your table has a list of the questions the night raised, with no fixes on it

stuck.if: The monitor doesn't run on your laptop yet
stuck.then: Watch the trainer's screen. You set up your laptop in chapter 02.

stuck.if: Business impact shows a different figure from the trainer's
stuck.then: Pick silent-night, select Replay and let it run to 08:00. Reset any sliders you moved.

handoff.note: Setup gets every laptop running the same monitor and tests, so the night you just watched can be replayed and changed.
